title: Nurturing care for early childhood development
author: WHO, UNICEF and World Bank Group
access: official publication overview
supports: Responsive caregiving, health, nutrition, safety and early learning are coordinated early-childhood priorities.
limitation: Does not validate this proposal's stage lengths or institutional model.

title: Autism Resources for Pediatricians
author: American Academy of Pediatrics
access: official guidance page
supports: General developmental screening at 9, 18 and 30 months; autism screening at 18 and 24 months; timely referral.
limitation: Clinical guidance is not an IQ, EQ or identity testing schedule and requires qualified local implementation.

title: Primary and lower secondary education
author: Finnish National Agency for Education
access: official page
supports: Nine-year basic education beginning in the year of the seventh birthday; associated free materials, meals and welfare provision.
limitation: Describes Finland; does not isolate causal effects or establish a universal calendar.

title: Primary Schools in Japan: Overview
author: National Institute for Educational Policy Research, Japan
access: PDF text, especially opening overview and classroom-teacher description
supports: 6–3–3–4 educational structure and primary classroom-teacher arrangements.
limitation: Historical description; current enrollment figures and regulations were not inferred from it.

title: Planes of Development and Sensitive Periods: Foundations of the Montessori Multi-Age Classroom
author: Cynthia Brunold-Conesa, American Montessori Society
access: institutional article
supports: Montessori developmental planes and multi-age environments provide a contrasting stage theory.
limitation: Description of a pedagogical theory, not genetic evidence or a comparative effectiveness trial.

title: Vocational education and training in Switzerland
author: Swiss Federal Council
access: official page, theory/practice and further-qualification sections
supports: Classroom instruction combined with paid workplace training and further educational pathways.
limitation: National outcomes cannot isolate calendar effects or justify a childhood employment commitment.

title: Career Academies: Long-Term Impacts on Work, Education, and Transitions to Adulthood
author: James J. Kemple, MDRC
access: evaluator's report overview and key findings; educational-attainment finding cross-checked against US Department of Labor study summary
supports: An employer-linked high-school package increased average earnings over eight years; educational-attainment gains were not established.
limitation: Nine US high schools; effects varied, and the full proposed life-course calendar was not tested.

title: Knowledge in Action: Efficacy Study Over Two Years
author: Anna Rosefsky Saavedra, Ying Liu, Shira Korn Haderlein, Amie Rapaport, Marshall Garland, Danial Hoepfner, Kari Lock Morgan and Alyssa Hu
access: original report PDF, executive summary and design sections
supports: Supported project curricula in two AP subjects improved first-year qualifying exam performance.
limitation: Curriculum plus teacher support package; later rollout comparisons differ from the first-year randomized control comparison.

title: Project-Based Learning – trial
author: Education Endowment Foundation; evaluation by Menzies and colleagues
type: randomized trial with substantial implementation and attrition limitations
access: official trial results and limitations
supports: No clear positive literacy or engagement effect; qualitative reports of possible teamwork and communication benefits.
limitation: Attrition and crossover weaken causal confidence; qualitative impressions do not establish learning gains.

title: Investigating the Promise of Integrated Student Supports: An Evaluation of the Community School Model in Tennessee
author: M. Truwit
access: author's university research-alliance abstract and findings
supports: Mixed outcomes after community-school adoption, including some improvements and increased chronic absenteeism.
limitation: Not randomized; does not test housing, adult services or this exact coordinated package.

title: Polygenic prediction of educational attainment within and between families from genome-wide association analyses in 3 million individuals
author: Aysu Okbay and colleagues
access: author manuscript repository record and abstract
supports: Educational-attainment associations combine direct and indirect/family-related influences.
limitation: Does not establish developmental stage lengths, fixed individual destiny, reproductive suitability or valid educational placement rules.

title: Survey on Social and Emotional Skills (SSES)
author: OECD
access: official page, assessment-limitations discussion
supports: Social-emotional self-assessments have comparability, validity and interpretation limits.
limitation: Not a validated universal EQ battery or an individual identity classification system.

title: The Teen Brain: 7 Things to Know
author: US National Institute of Mental Health
access: official overview
supports: Developmental changes extend into the twenties; adolescents remain capable of learning and adaptation.
limitation: A broad developmental account cannot determine an individual's legal capacity, family timing or retreat age.

title: Rights on having children
author: World Health Organization
access: official page updated 30 September 2022
supports: People choose whether to have children and their number, spacing and timing.
limitation: A rights principle, not evidence of a universally optimal age for pregnancy or a substitute for local legal/clinical advice.

title: Convention on the Rights of the Child
author: United Nations
access: UN-hosted text; Articles 12, 16, 29 and 32
supports: A child's views, privacy, educational development and protection from harmful work are relevant principles.
limitation: Domestic implementation differs; this proposal is not a jurisdiction-specific legal assessment.

title: International technical guidance on sexuality education: An evidence-informed approach
author: UNESCO and partner UN agencies
access: official publication summary; publication year distinguished from page-update date
supports: Structured, age-appropriate relationships and sexuality education within a rights framework.
limitation: Does not authorize compulsory matchmaking, reproductive targets or institutional permission to form a family.

title: Guide for Policymakers – Quality Apprenticeships Recommendation, 2023 (No. 208)
author: International Labour Organization
type: implementation guidance for an international recommendation
access: official guide overview; Recommendation 208 cross-checked
supports: Structured apprenticeships, fair remuneration, safe conditions, inclusion and social protection.
limitation: Not a local employment contract or evidence for a ten-year childhood labor obligation.

title: Guidelines on mental health at work
author: World Health Organization
access: official publication overview and recommendation summary
supports: Organizational interventions, accommodations and return-to-work support are relevant to worker wellbeing.
limitation: Does not establish the best age or duration for a developmental retreat; recommendation certainty varies.

title: I need a vacation: A meta-analysis of vacation and employee well-being
author: Ryan S. Grant, Beth E. Buchanan and Kristen M. Shockley
access: original paper's indexed abstract; 32 studies and 256 effect sizes
supports: Vacation improves employee wellbeing, with a more sustained pattern than earlier meta-analytic accounts suggested.
limitation: Does not evaluate a mandatory three-year retreat, a 27–30 age optimum or the proposed longer break options.

title: NLS News Releases
author: US Bureau of Labor Statistics
access: release index, including 5 May 2026 NLSY97 summary
supports: Early-career job mobility is common in the tracked US cohorts.
limitation: Descriptive cohort data; not a career prediction or a causal test of educational timing.
